question: What is the air quality in Pegoh, Ipoh right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
At **Pegoh, Ipoh**, the latest displayed station reading is **US AQI 156 — Unhealthy** (reported for **5–6 a.m. Malaysia time, October 16**). Air quality readings can change hour to hour. ([iqair.com](https://www.iqair.com/air-quality/malaysia/perak/ipoh))
